events.title: New Map on the Way: The Neighbors Suspect Nothing
events.summary: Hey there, cleaners! We couldn't show up to Next Fest empty-handed. Right now, we're busy adding a brand-new map to the demo! This time, you're headed to a quiet, peaceful suburban neighborhood with spotless white picket fences. The houses are a bit smaller, but don't be fooled: the job doesn't end at the front door. events.title: New Feature : Hand Cuffing Update
events.summary: Hey everyone!The police department just got a budget increase. This update gives cops new tools, makes their arrival more dramatic, and fixes a bunch of things you reported. Here's what's new: New: HandcuffsHold the button for 2 seconds to cuff a suspect.Cuffed suspects move slower for 20 seconds and can't carry items or bodies.Suspects who are down on the ground can be cuffed too.Cops can cuff each other as well, but only for 5 seconds.
